name.description: Instance name (lowercase alphanumeric only, no dashes or spaces)

instanceType.description:
Instance type

Available types:
- U1 series: u1.medium, u1.large, u1.xlarge, u1.2xlarge, u1.4xlarge, u1.8xlarge
- S1 series: s1.small, s1.medium, s1.large, s1.xlarge, s1.3large, s1.2xlarge, s1.3xlarge, s1.4xlarge, s1.8xlarge
- M1 series: m1.large, m1.xlarge, m1.2xlarge, m1.4xlarge, m1.8xlarge

name.description:
Disk name.
If disk name already exists in the Tenant, it will be used

encrypted.description: Enable disk encryption. Ignored when the disk already exists; only honored when a new disk is created via this request.

asyncReplication.description: Use async replication (sync replication is the default). Ignored when the disk already exists; only honored when a new disk is created via this request.

local.description: True if the disk uses non-replicated local storage. Read-only; legacy disks may still report true.

disks.description:
Declare your disks here
The system disk has to be in first position

publicIpv4.description:
Enable external access to your VM
with a public IPv4

enabled.description: Enable firewall functions to filter access ports

allowedInboundPorts.description: Specify list of ports to expose

subnets.description:
Subnet names within this VPC to connect to.
Each subnet adds secondary network interfaces to the VM.

gpus.description: GPU types (see GPU service for available types)

sshKeys.description:
Specify all your ssh keys to add to your instance
You need to add a minimum of one ssh key
The following public key algorithms are available :
ssh-ed25519
sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com
ecdsa-sha2-nistp256
ecdsa-sha2-nistp384
ecdsa-sha2-nistp521
sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com
ssh-rsa

userData.description:
Cloud-Init UserData script. Not available for Windows VMs: the initialization
script is managed automatically to set the administrator password.
Start with #cloud-config. For custom (imported) Linux images, cloud-init
must be installed on the image.

automaticRestart.description:
When enabled, the VM automatically restarts 
even after a shutdown from the guest OS.
